get.summary: Read saved listener settings and actual runtime state
get.description: Session only; no query. Rechecks the current local administrator; observing an externally controlled node does not grant local write authority. Schema27 enables Web configuration; startup-file and witnessed Source modes do not expose this writer. Saved enabled is desired state, not proof of listening or connectivity. Runtime generation belongs only to this process; configuration_revision identifies the durable configuration actually reached, which may differ from saved revision.

put.summary: Persist and apply one bounded local listener configuration
put.description: Session/CSRF only, schema27 required, no query, body <=10240 wire bytes. Rechecks actual administrator, local owner epoch, expected node and configuration CAS. Accepts one cold operation plus one queued operation; persists exact original request and terminal receipt before confirming. An HTTP timeout/cancel does not cancel admitted work. Query the original revision (expected_revision+1), request_id and controller_epoch after response loss; never automatically replay or adopt the latest task. At most256 contiguous receipts are retained. Restart interrupts pending receipts and separately restores desired settings; it does not rewrite the old result as applied. Changes drain old listeners before replacement; failed bind keeps management alive. Existing credentials/policy remain. Node-default routing requires no IPAM resource and does not grant a revoked route. HTTPS/Auto/MASQUE reuse the node's normal identity and protocol policy, never its ACME challenge. Does not edit DNS, firewall or files supplied by clients. Automation credentials confer no service authority.

202.description: Exact receipt and a runtime observation. Inspect state; HTTP acceptance alone is not success.

get.summary: Query an original listener operation without replay
get.description: Session only. Current administrator, local node ownership and epoch must still match; receipt must belong to the same administrator, revision and request ID. No latest-result adoption, payload, secret or automatic retry. Missing/evicted/denied receipt does not prove the operation never ran. This read does not resume interrupted work.

200.description: Original retained receipt, not a current connectivity test.

ProxyServiceConfiguration.description: Non-secret canonical stored JSON <=8192 bytes, 1..16 listeners. Binds use numeric non-multicast IPs and nonzero ports; same transport+SocketAddr cannot repeat. TCP and MASQUE UDP may share a port. Management/node TCP ports are protected. Public addresses are descriptive declarations, not bind/reachability/egress evidence.

ProxyServiceSaved.description: Only initial revision1 disabled state has null configuration. Enabled is desired, not live state.

generation.description: Process-local u64 or null for startup mode; never a persistent CAS.
